onboarding.tagline: Chat, plan and share with the people you trust.
onboarding.privacyNote: End-to-end encrypted. No phone number required. Your identity stays on this device.
onboarding.nameHelp: This is what your friends will see. You can change it later.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shareCodeHelp: Let a friend scan this to add you.
settings.identityCreated: Identity created {{date}}. Your private key never leaves this device.
settings.appearanceHelp: Pick an accent colour and a light or dark canvas. Changes apply instantly.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language for the app. Languages without a complete translation fall back to English.
settings.readReceiptsHelp: When off, your peers can't tell when you read their messages. Both sides need this on for either to see receipts.
settings.typingIndicatorHelp: Symmetric — when on, you send typing pings AND see peers'. When off, neither side does.
settings.notificationsHelp: Control which events raise a notification. The OS permission must be granted first.
settings.notifPermissionDenied: Notifications blocked — enable them in your device settings
settings.notifChannelDmsHelp: A new message in a one-to-one chat.
settings.notifChannelEventsHelp: Upcoming events you've been invited to.
settings.storageHelp: On-device storage used by the app. Clearing the cache won't delete your identity or messages.
settings.clearCacheHelp: Removes the offline portal cache and other rebuildable data.
settings.deleteConfirm: Sign out? This will permanently delete your identity and all messages on this device. This cannot be undone.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.setupExplain: We'll generate a secp256k1 keypair on this device. The private key never leaves your phone — it lives in the device keychain.
wallet.setupAddressNote: Your address is what merchants scan to charge you. It's public — share freely.
wallet.taxHint: Tap Tax for an estimated position based on your declared residency. Per FutureChain's tax policy this is an estimate only — see the disclaimer on the tax screen.
wallet.receiveHelp: Show this code to whoever's paying you. They scan it with their wallet to pick the amount.
wallet.sendHelp: Paste a merchant's futurechain:pay link, or a recipient's address.
wallet.sendV0Note: v0: this records the tx for your ledger. Network broadcast lands with the FutureChain RPC client.

tax.title: Tax
tax.residencyHelp: Pick the country you're tax resident in. We use this to apply the right rules — it stays on this device.
tax.residencyDeclared: Per FutureChain's tax policy, residency is declared, not inferred from your location. Re-confirm yearly or whenever it changes. If you live in multiple countries during the year, talk to a tax adviser — Anton doesn't split jurisdictions.
tax.estimateOnly: Estimate only — not a tax bill. See disclaimer below.
